rv.q: Both Nyman and Feiler are superb, but it's Eva Feiler as Louise who delivers the standout performance.
It turned out to be remarkably engaging, and oozing with refreshing optimism without descending into saccharine emotions and goopy melodrama.
Superbly acted, directed and produced, Dear Jack, Dear Louise is also helped by the original letters' frequent wit and panache.
Refreshing, amusing and moving, 'Dear Jack, Dear Louise' brings hope and love to a world fractured by war where everything feels impossible.
I laughed, I cried, I gasped, and there were audible 'awws' heard throughout the unfurling of Jack and Louise's love story.

Although the germ of Dear Jack, Dear Louise exhibits aptitude, the script limits itself to an overly conventional execution, where a basic recipe is followed to the letter without any additional spices.
